name: Morph study / a shape for the change
art: The targets and particle transitions are original code. Preserve point identity and authored geometry instead of importing third-party brand illustrations or source screenshots.

properties.label: Editorial heading beside a particle structure
properties.text: On a warm mint field, place a large expressive heading beside a clear three-dimensional particle structure, with compact shape and formation controls below. Give the point cloud enough area, density and contrast to balance the type.

properties.label: Stable particles resolving authored geometry
properties.text: Use stable point identities sampled into recognizable authored target geometries. Let distribution, overlap and density describe depth; keep text outside the rendering layer and avoid diffuse dust that loses the chosen shape.

properties.label: Deep green points on pale mint
properties.text: Use fine deep-green points on a pale warm-mint ground, with enough contrast for the resting target at mobile size.

properties.label: Interruptible geometry retargeting
properties.text: Sphere, Current and Loop move the same particles among authored targets with restrained rotation; Formation changes how tightly they resolve. Retarget from current positions, preserve stable identities, and provide an intentional completed state for pause and reduced motion.

properties.label: Expressive serif particle-study type
properties.text: Use an expressive editorial heading with Instrument Serif emphasis, balanced by a sans base and quiet precise controls, labels and supporting copy.

properties.label: Particle transition integrity
properties.text: Compare resting targets and transitions separately. Reject an intermediate stall, abrupt stale shape, chaotic reassignment or weak mobile contrast. Test reversals, formation extremes and resource disposal.
